fields.statement: QA at the branch head: built rhiza with go build -trimpath; rhiza guide import step 4 prints both wording forms ('<decided>, made by the owner as recorded in <document>' when the document records the owner making or confirming it, else the agent-made autonomous form), both with no quote field and a derived-from link to the Source. In a fresh scratch git repo, following the guide by hand, added a capability, a decisions-md Source and one decision of each form, each decided-by the capability and derived-from the Source; proposed, accepted, landed and rendered. rhiza check printed ok (exit 0); rhiza why on the capability and on each decision showed each wording and the Source decisions-md; rhiza show --json of each decision had no quote. go test ./internal/guide/... and TestScripts/(guide|import-.*) pass.
